_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in a coil with 6% break base rate, neutral momentum/funding, and offsetting fuels—no breaker visible, so HOLD is the graded call.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on Disbelief and measured/non-directional stance; narrative adds no opposing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays inside roughly ±3% and momentum plus funding hold the 45-55 band with ETF flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum breaks below ~40 with Fear & Greed through 50 and skew still extreme (down), or momentum breaks above ~65 with funding and ETF flows lifting together (up)
